topic.title: Accept Against Reject
topic.shortdesc: Unlike every other file in this dataset, this base already carries review markup. A accepts it, B rejects it.

section.title: Overview
section.p: The Authentication Service validates user credentials and issues signed access tokens. It runs as a stateless component and can be scaled horizontally.
section.note: Never commit the signing key to the repository.

section.title: Configuring the service
section.p: The configuration file is read once, at startup. Restart the service after every change.

ol.li: Start the service and check the health endpoint.
